exposure: uterine artery flow (UtAF) parameters (Doppler ultrasonography, pulsatility index, notch)
cohort: 77 singleton pregnant women with gestational hypertension, of whom 36 progressed to preeclampsia (cases) and 41 did not (controls).
finding: Serum soluble endoglin (sEng) concentration was found to be a significant and independent predictor of progression to preeclampsia, preterm delivery <34 weeks of gestation, and fetal growth restriction.
cross-section timing: Measurements for sEng and UtAF were performed at enrollment, with outcomes observed subsequently during pregnancy.
